title: Why Airbus and Boeing Are Buying More From India in 2026
description: Airbus just sourced aerospace-grade titanium from India for the first time, through a supplier now also machining parts for Safran's jet engines. Boeing already buys over $1.25 billion a year through 300+ Indian suppliers. Here's what's driving it, and what it takes to be part of it.

title: US Tariffs in 2026: Why a 25% Duty Still Doesn't Beat the Case for VAVE-Engineered Indian Sourcing
description: Section 232 puts a 25% duty on most Indian-machined metal parts landing in the US as of August 2026, but the labor-cost gap between US and Indian CNC shops is still wide enough to win, if the part is engineered for it, not just quoted for it.
